fact: The document is the text of the Statistics Act, 2005 of The Gambia, held as an image-only scan with no readable body, dated by the year in its short title because no assent or gazette date is readable.

GBoS's NSDS III says the 2005 Statistics Act governs statistical activities in The Gambia, provides for the national statistical system and establishes GBoS as its supervisory authority; the strategy was published 2023-09.

NSDS III says the Statistics Act is under revision with stakeholder inputs, and plans to review the 2019 Statistics Bill, advocate for its enactment and adopt a new statistics law by 2026; strategy published 2023-09.
